title: Pack
description: A texture pack: one that is hosted, one held back, or one that is only known to exist (hosting.state listed). One file per pack at data/packs/<key>.yaml holds everything about it. People edit the descriptive fields; the `archive` block (hashes, sizes, object names) is written by the conversion pipeline.

key.description: Immutable repo handle, equal to the file name: <lowest serial>-<lead creator id>[-n], or <game title>-<lead creator id>[-n] for a pack with no serial yet. Short on purpose, so paths stay valid on Windows.

catalog_id.description: The id the app sees, when it predates this repo (the 517 inherited ids; up to 228 characters, never changed). Absent for new packs, whose id is `key`.

serials.description: The app matches a pack to a game by serial, so a hosted pack needs at least one; a pack that is only listed may have none yet.

regions.description: For a pack with no serial: the regions the Texture Packs Archive lists it for.

credits.description: Who made it, lead first. Empty means no one has named the creator, which is different from a missing field.

listed_credits.description: Creators the Texture Packs Archive names for this pack when `credits` does not. Shown beside the pack and on those creators' pages; not used for the catalog.

version.description: The pack's version as its creator labels it. Shown with the pack in the app's catalog.

sources.description: Pages about the pack: where it is announced or distributed. Never the address of our own copy.

access.description: What the pack costs the public where its creator distributes it. Absent when not known. A hosted pack that is paid needs the creator's approval in `permission`.

permission.description: Our right to host a copy. Separate from cost: free to download is not permission to redistribute.

state.description: published: hosted. listed: known to exist elsewhere and not hosted. withheld: we have it and hold it back.

media.description: Example pictures and videos for the pack's page. Pictures are the creator's own screenshots and are credited to them. Image files are never in git: `source_url` is where the creator shows it, `storage_key` names our resized copy once made. A video is a YouTube id; the site shows a thumbnail and loads the player only on a click.

credit.description: Creator id of whoever made the picture.

needs_review.description: Credits nobody has checked yet; a person removes an entry once checked. Facts that can be computed (no matching listing, paid but hosted) are reported by `ps2ktxpak report`, never stored here.

download.description: For a pack that is not hosted: where its files were found by following its source page, and how sure. An address is recorded only when it was seen on a public page; nothing is downloaded to find it.

archive.description: What the conversion pipeline produced for this pack. Written by the pipeline, never by hand. A new revision is appended, an old one is never changed, and objects are never overwritten under the same name.

object.description: Storage key under the archive host, e.g. packs/<id>.tar.zst.

source.description: The download this archive was converted from.
